name: proxmox
description: Full Proxmox VE integration for VM and container management. Monitor cluster health, manage VMs and LXC containers, track resource usage, and execute lifecycle actions.
shortDescription: VM and container management for Proxmox clusters.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Full cluster overview with quorum status

clusterOverview.name: Cluster Overview
clusterOverview.description: See all nodes, quorum status, and cluster health at a glance.

vmManagement.name: VM Management
vmManagement.description: List, start, stop, and reboot virtual machines across all nodes.

containerManagement.name: Container Management
containerManagement.description: Manage LXC containers - view status, resource usage, and lifecycle.

resourceMonitoring.name: Resource Monitoring
resourceMonitoring.description: Track CPU, memory, and disk usage per VM and container.

snapshotManagement.name: Snapshot Management
snapshotManagement.description: View and manage VM snapshots across the cluster.

nodeStatus.name: Node Status

storageOverview.name: Storage Overview
